description: NCA Interactive Atlas is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by USGCRP, U.S. Global Change Research Program; NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information; Esri. The Atlas is an extension of the Fifth National Climate Assessment (NCA5), providing interactive access to maps and data used in NCA5. The initial release offers maps showing 15 variables of downscaled climate projections at 4 levels of global warming. Released in 2023, the Fifth National Climate Assessment (NCA5) is the U.S. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Drought, Extreme Heat, Flooding – General, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Economy, Energy and Utilities, Natural Areas and Wildlife, People, Property, Water Infrastructure – Stormwater. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
